facts.fact: An AI-powered initiative led by Studia Inc. digitised over 10 million civil registration records, which the report says accelerated Madagascar's national digital ID enrolment.

Authorities said more than six million people had been enrolled in Madagascar's biometric ID scheme by June 2026, about 18% of 32.7 million people (share computed from the population given), against a 12 million target.

MDG.note: No number at birth is stated.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Madagascar is building its national digital ID under the World Bank-funded PRODIGY project ($143 million), with more than six million enrolled for the biometric scheme as of June 2026.
